call.title: Introductory call transcript
call.text:
I DO! VENDOR INTRODUCTION
Call transcript | November 1, 2026, 10:00 a.m.
Rep: Jamie Rivera | Vendor: Jordan Brooks, Smoke & Honey Catering
FICTIONAL SAMPLE SOURCE

[00:00] Jamie: Tell me about what you do and who you are a good fit for.
[00:19] Jordan Brooks: We offer BBQ catering, buffet service, vegetarian menus, late-night snacks. Our style is Texas barbecue with seasonal Southern sides. Capacity-wise, 50–250 guests; 50-guest minimum.

[02:10] Jamie: Walk me through what's included and what you need.
[02:22] Jordan Brooks: Standard service is 3-hour staffed dinner service. The team is Chef + one server per 25 guests. We can customize with Vegetarian mains; gluten-free sides; late-night snacks. Exclusions are Alcohol, tables, linens, and china. From the venue or client, we need Potable water; covered prep area; loading access.

[06:05] Jamie: How do bookings and payments work?
[06:20] Jordan Brooks: The deposit is 30% non-refundable retainer. The balance is due 30 days before the event. We recommend booking 9–12 months ahead.
[07:02] Jamie: And changes or cancellations?
[07:14] Jordan Brooks: Retainer is non-refundable; within 30 days the full balance is due. For rescheduling: One date change within 12 months, subject to availability.

[09:35] Jamie: What happens on the day?
[09:46] Jordan Brooks: Two-hour load-in; 45-minute breakdown. Our backup plan is Backup warming equipment; alternate supplier; weather-protected buffet.
[10:50] Jamie: What about delivery and deadlines?
[11:02] Jordan Brooks: The deadline on the website is vague. I will send the actual planning or fulfillment deadline. I'll email you the latest timeline.

[13:12] Jamie: Please also confirm the package prices and send insurance documentation.
[13:25] Jordan Brooks: The website rates are out of date. I'll send our current rate card and a follow-up email. I still need to send our certificate.

[14:00] Jamie: Thanks. We will keep the profile pending until the documents are reviewed.
